findings.claim: Some memories are matched only by topic key or exact content because their observation was never imported. That fallback cannot tell a mirror from an independent memory that shares the key or text, so such a memory is archived if it was last written before the deletion. Keys that claimTopicKey moved to <key>~N are never found, which is a miss and loses nothing.
